name: Chinese Universe Publishing and Media Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Chinese Universe Publishing and Media Group Co., Ltd. engages in the editing and publishing of books, newspapers, periodicals, and audio-visual electronic publications in China and internationally. It also offers domestic and foreign trade and supply chain services, logistics, and Internet of Things technology applications; and new media, online education, internet games, digital publishing, film and television production, art dealing, cultural complexes, and investment and financing. In addition, the company offers textbooks and supplementary teaching materials, printing and packaging, logistics, material trading, new business models, and integrated marketing services.
